fields.resolution: Implemented and validated live on branch agent/298fdd43-fa02-43e3-ad11-23d72509585f/session (commit 3e536169) in worktree .worktrees/298fdd43-fa02-43e3-ad11-23d72509585f/session. Delivered: bootstrap.sh (single entry point, per-step reporting, hard-stop with remediation hint); .github/mcp.json fixed to mcpServers key (copilot mcp list: 0 -> 11 servers); tools/install/sync-copilot-surfaces.sh copies .agents/{agents,prompts,instructions} into gitignored .github/{agents,prompts,instructions} Copilot CLI auto-discovers (verified 33 agents + 23 prompts present); init.sh copilot-init now idempotent (skips once copilot-instructions.md is populated, avoiding repeat nested-session credit spend); tools/repair-submodule-worktrees.sh auto-detects+fixes the staged-deleted submodule corruption pattern (reproduced and verified fixed); install-tools.sh dry-run success/failure accounting bug fixed (reproduced with a corrupted manifest, verified failed=1 now reported correctly); README.md documents ./bootstrap.sh as primary entry point. Full end-to-end bash bootstrap.sh run in a clean worktree (fresh submodule clones, real install-tools --mcp --force, real cargo check --workspace) completed with 'Bootstrap verification passed.' Deferred/out of scope for this pass: fixing the stale context-mcp README reference to a nonexistent .github/context-mcp-config.json, since that file lives in the context-stack submodule and needs its own branch per the bottom-up submodule integration workflow. Ready for review/merge by orchestrator.
